_note: portal-change-proposals-on-the-case D2. The handler accepts or rejects a resident's proposed correction on the case page, through portaliq's portaliq-change-proposal-queue leaf (portaliq RegisterProposalLeavesListener::QUEUE_LEAF_ID). linkedTypes is a LIST and fragments concatenate lists, so this adds the one id. Without portaliq the leaf is never registered and the panel is absent.
